thread:
maria: FYI — invoice-preview for tenant acme is showing ~30% fewer tokens compared to final ledger. Spotted after the route-tag canonicalization rollout this morning.

oliver: Hmm. Did the route resolver change mapping rules? Which route/model is affected?

maria: Hosted traffic. route_tag 'embed-heavy' should resolve to route_id r-42; ledger shows r-42 but invoice preview is attributing to r-guest. Looks like preview pipeline is falling back to an old billing_route field.

devon: Can you paste a sample event header so we can see what fields made it through?

maria: sure, here's one:
```
{
  "req_id": "req_9876",
  "route_tag": "embed-heavy",
  "route_id": "r-42",
  "billing_route": "r-guest",
  "tokens": 120
}
```

jia: That billing_route shouldn't be present downstream — enrichment must have been missed and the preview pipeline defaulted to legacy billing_route when join failed.

sam: I saw something similar on the canary yesterday. Telemetry shows enrich join TTL=5s but ingest->enrich lag spikes to ~7s on a subset of shards during peak, so enrichment records are missing at join time.

maria: The preview pipeline reads from shadow topic S and enrichment from E; if consumer group E lags, preview falls back. We need to confirm consumer lag and widen join or prefer canonical route_id.

oliver: Can you run a quick query to quantify?

maria: ran a rough query: SELECT count(*) FROM preview_events WHERE billing_route != route_id AND ts >= now() - interval '24 hours'; result: ~1.2k mismatches, concentrated between 11:30-12:10 PST when ingestion peaked.

devon: Proposed fix: change preview pipeline to prefer route_id (canonical) over billing_route and make fallback explicit. I have a small patch ready (PR #2345) that flips the preference and adds a small grace window.

jia: Also recommend adding a metric enrich.join_lag (histogram) and an alert when p95 > 2s for more than 5m. That would have caught this earlier.

sam: Agreed. We should also run a backfill to reconcile the preview vs ledger for the last 24h and emit correction events so invoice preview aligns for customers.

maria: Plan/owners: @devon — cut and deploy PR for preference change; @jia — add metric + alert; @sam — run backfill job and post-run diff; I'll draft the postmortem and update console rollout notes.

ingest-bot: deploy-canary: preview-service v1.21 -> v1.22 triggered by devon at 6701234578

oliver: Nice. Please add a short note in the console changelog about the invoice_preview mapping change and the reconciliation window so support knows what to say to customers.

maria: Will do. Thanks all :thumbsup:
